title: Right2Water
objective: Implement the human right to water and sanitation as recognised by the United Nations, and promote the provision of water and sanitation as essential public services for all.
commission_answer: The Commission adopted a Communication responding to the Right2Water initiative, committing to assess and reinforce implementation of EU water legislation and to ensure universal access to safe drinking water. It also launched a public consultation on the Drinking Water Directive.

title: Stop Vivisection
objective: Abrogate Directive 2010/63/EU on the protection of animals used for scientific purposes and re-direct EU research towards human-biology-based sciences.
commission_answer: The Commission, while acknowledging public concern over animal testing, concluded that an immediate abrogation of Directive 2010/63/EU would be counterproductive. It committed to further implementation of the 3Rs principle (Replace, Reduce, Refine) and to promoting the development of alternative methods.

title: Single Communication Tariff Act
objective: Introduce a single, affordable EU-wide tariff for cross-border mobile and internet communications to eliminate roaming charges across member states.

title: Minority SafePack
objective: Adopt a set of legal acts to improve the protection of persons belonging to national and linguistic minorities and strengthen cultural and linguistic diversity in the EU.
commission_answer: The Commission acknowledged the importance of minority rights but concluded that the proposed measures exceeded its legislative competence in several areas. It committed to monitoring compliance with fundamental rights standards in member states and to supporting minority languages through existing funding programmes.

title: Let Me Vote
objective: Allow EU citizens to vote in all elections in their member state of residence, removing restrictions on electoral participation for non-national EU residents.

title: New Deal for Europe
objective: Launch a European plan for sustainable development and quality employment financed by a tax on financial transactions to combat austerity and unemployment across member states.

title: Stop TTIP
objective: Request the Council to repeal the negotiating mandate for TTIP and not to conclude CETA, due to concerns over regulatory standards, investor-state dispute settlement, and democratic accountability.

title: One of Us — Embryo Protection
objective: Prohibit the EU from financing activities which presuppose the destruction of human embryos, in particular in the areas of research, development aid and public health.
commission_answer: The Commission concluded that the existing legal framework governing EU funding in the areas of research, development aid and public health already contains adequate safeguards. It did not consider it appropriate to amend the relevant regulations as requested.

title: Unconditional Basic Income for Europe
objective: Explore and promote unconditional basic income as an instrument to improve social security systems across the EU, ensuring every person's material needs are met.

title: Compulsory Labelling of Meat Products
objective: Require mandatory country-of-origin labelling for all meat and processed meat products sold in the EU to improve consumer transparency and food traceability.

title: Ban Glyphosate and Protect People and the Environment
objective: Ban glyphosate herbicides, reform pesticide approval procedures, and set mandatory EU-wide reduction targets for pesticide use to protect people and the environment.
commission_answer: The Commission acknowledged the wide public concern and committed to not renewing authorisation of glyphosate without full scientific reassessment. It proposed reforms to the transparency of scientific studies and pledged to develop a post-2020 sustainability strategy for pesticides.

title: Initiative for More Democracy in Europe
objective: Introduce direct democratic instruments at EU level including citizens' referendums on major EU policy decisions and binding EU-wide consultations on Treaty changes.

title: Sustainable Food for All
objective: Shift EU food and farming policy towards sustainable agriculture, reducing pesticide dependency, improving animal welfare standards and ensuring fair income for farmers.

title: Access to Social Protection for All Workers
objective: Extend access to adequate social protection schemes to all workers regardless of employment status, including self-employed, platform, and part-time workers.

title: Inclusion of People with Disabilities
objective: Strengthen the rights of people with disabilities in the EU by ensuring equal access to employment, education, healthcare and social protection in all member states.

title: Our Common Future — Environment and Climate
objective: Establish legally binding long-term EU climate targets and require all member states to align national energy and climate plans with the Paris Agreement 1.5°C pathway.

title: Coherence of EU Agricultural Policy with Green Deal
objective: Align the Common Agricultural Policy with the European Green Deal by making direct payments conditional on environmental and climate performance indicators.

title: We Are A Welcoming Europe
objective: Promote a humane and rights-based EU asylum and migration policy by decriminalising solidarity acts, protecting rescuers at sea and ensuring fair reception conditions.

title: Save Cruelty Free Cosmetics
objective: Establish a global ban on animal testing for cosmetics by 2023 and ensure no cosmetics animal-test data can be used for EU market access, reinforcing the EU's cruelty-free cosmetics model worldwide.
commission_answer: The Commission expressed its commitment to maintaining the EU's world-leading ban on animal testing for cosmetics and pledged to work towards international convergence. It announced plans to develop a roadmap for ending animal testing in cosmetics globally through bilateral and multilateral engagement.

title: Good Food Good Farming
objective: Transform EU food and farming by phasing out factory farming, cutting pesticide use by 80% by 2030 and redirecting agricultural subsidies to support agroecological farming practices.

title: One of Us
objective: Prohibit the EU from financing activities which presuppose the destruction of human embryos in particular in the areas of research development aid and public health.

title: Universal Basic Income EU
objective: Introduce an unconditional basic income for all EU residents financed through a common EU-level fund.

title: Stop Finning - Stop the Trade
objective: Prohibit the import, export, sale, and offer for sale of loose shark fins and all products containing shark fins other than fins naturally attached to the shark's body in the European Union.
commission_answer: The Commission is conducting an impact assessment to evaluate extending the 'fins naturally attached' policy to imports and exports. A legislative proposal addressing the shark fin trade is expected within the current mandate.

title: Free Public Transport
objective: Introduce free urban and regional public transport services across all EU member states to reduce car dependency and carbon emissions.

title: Protect Old Growth Forests
objective: Establish a binding EU moratorium on logging in remaining old-growth and primary forests within EU territory and create a permanent protection status for identified areas.

title: Ban Microplastics
objective: Require EU-wide phase-out of intentionally added microplastics in cosmetics, detergents and agricultural products by 2028.

title: Ban Factory Farming
objective: Prohibit intensive factory farming practices across all EU member states and phase out battery cages, gestation crates and overcrowded housing systems by 2030.

title: End the Cage Age
objective: Propose legislation to phase out and ultimately prohibit the use of cages for farmed animals including laying hens, rabbits, pullets, broiler breeders, layer breeders, quail, ducks and geese.
commission_answer: The Commission commits to propose legislation to phase out and ban the use of cages for all animals listed in the initiative by 2027, in line with the Farm to Fork Strategy objectives and following a thorough impact assessment.

title: Ban Glyphosate Renewal
objective: Prevent the renewal of the EU authorisation for the herbicide glyphosate and phase out its use in all EU member states by 2025.

title: Digital Rights Charter
objective: Enshrine digital rights including the right to encryption, offline alternatives and algorithmic transparency into a binding EU charter.

title: Right to Water
objective: Recognise access to safe drinking water and sanitation as a human right, exclude water services from internal market rules and liberalisation, and strengthen EU efforts to achieve universal access to water and sanitation.
commission_answer: Following the European Citizens' Initiative 'Right2Water', the Commission carried out a public consultation and adopted a Communication reaffirming the commitment that water is a public good and a human right. The revised Drinking Water Directive adopted in 2020 strengthens the universal access obligation.
legislation: Following the initiative, the Commission proposed a revision of the Drinking Water Directive. On 16 December 2020, the European Parliament formally adopted the revised Drinking Water Directive (Directive (EU) 2020/2184). The Directive entered into force on 12 January 2021. Member States had until 12 January 2023 to transpose it into national legislation, introducing mandatory access to safe water for vulnerable and marginalised groups.

title: Fur Free Europe
objective: Ban the farming of animals for their fur across all EU member states and prohibit the import and export of fur and fur products into and from the EU.
commission_answer: The Commission acknowledges the citizens' concerns regarding animal welfare in fur farming. It will assess the feasibility of an EU-wide ban in the context of the upcoming revision of the Animal Welfare legislation and the Farm to Fork Strategy.
legislation: The European Parliament adopted a resolution on 14 February 2023 calling on the Commission to propose a Union-wide ban on fur farming and the placing on the market of fur products. The Commission included a legislative proposal on the welfare of farmed animals, covering fur farming, in its 2024–2029 Work Programme. A Regulation phasing out fur farming across all EU Member States was adopted on 22 October 2025 and entered into force on 1 January 2026, with a transitional period for existing farms until 31 December 2027.

title: EU Housing Guarantee
objective: Establish a legally binding EU-level right to affordable housing and require member states to cap rent increases and expand social housing stock.

title: Mandatory Climate Education
objective: Require all EU member states to include mandatory climate change and sustainability education in national school curricula from primary level onwards.

title: Fair Digital Platform Work
objective: Guarantee minimum standards for platform workers, including transparent algorithmic management, fair pay, and effective collective bargaining rights.

title: End Dark Patterns Online
objective: Prohibit deceptive dark pattern design practices in online platforms and require transparent user interfaces that respect informed consent.

title: Save Bees and Farmers
objective: Restore biodiversity and transition to nature-friendly farming by reducing synthetic pesticide use by 80% by 2030 and restoring natural ecosystems on at least 10% of agricultural land.

title: Protect Whistleblowers in EU Funds
objective: Improve protection for whistleblowers reporting fraud and corruption involving EU funds, with secure reporting channels and safeguards against retaliation.

title: Ban Facial Recognition in Public
objective: Prohibit real-time facial recognition and biometric mass surveillance in publicly accessible spaces across the EU, with narrow exceptions.

title: Stop Greenwashing Claims
objective: Prohibit misleading environmental marketing claims by requiring substantiation, standard labels, and strong penalties for repeat offenders.

title: European Rail Night Revival
objective: Create an EU framework to expand cross-border night trains, improve ticketing interoperability, and prioritise rail over short-haul flights.

title: European Accessible Cities
objective: Ensure barrier-free access in public spaces and transport by setting EU accessibility benchmarks for cities and funding upgrades.

title: Ban PFAS Forever Chemicals
objective: Phase out PFAS in consumer products and industrial uses where safer alternatives exist, with strict derogations and full transparency.

title: EU Right to Repair Plus
objective: Strengthen the right to repair by extending spare-parts availability, mandating repairability scores, and limiting software locks that hinder repair.

title: Clean Air for Europe
objective: Set binding EU-wide air quality targets aligned with WHO guidelines, strengthen enforcement, and expand monitoring in urban areas.

title: Protect EU Borders
objective: Strengthen EU external border controls and establish a permanent EU border protection force with enhanced mandate to prevent illegal crossings and ensure the security of member states' territorial integrity.

title: AI Regulation for Workers
objective: Ensure that AI systems used in employment contexts are subject to human oversight, algorithmic transparency, and workers' right to explanation for any automated decision affecting their employment conditions.

title: Tax the Rich
objective: Introduce a progressive EU-wide net wealth tax on individuals holding assets above €1 million to fund the green transition, reduce inequality, and finance public services across member states.

title: Europe for Mental Health
objective: Adopt an EU mental health action plan with minimum service standards, prevention measures, and dedicated funding for youth support.

title: Protect EU Digital Sovereignty
objective: Require the EU to develop and maintain sovereign digital infrastructure reducing dependency on non-EU cloud providers and ensuring EU citizens data is processed exclusively within EU jurisdiction.

title: Ban Surveillance Advertising
objective: Prohibit the use of personal data for targeted advertising purposes across all digital platforms operating within the European Union to protect citizens privacy and mental health.
